_guide: New meme shirt ideas from the AI trend hunter, waiting for Maddox's OK. Each idea is a complete catalog/designs.json entry plus why/src. To publish one: ask Claude 'make the new Hot Dropic designs' in a session with your hotdropic GitHub Desktop folder connected. Claude moves it into designs.json, renders it with scripts/make-designs.py, checks how it looks, and commits; then click Push origin. Ideas older than 3 weeks can be deleted.

ideas.name: Cozymaxxing
ideas.blurb: Blanket on. Plans off. Fully maxxing. For the person who treats staying in like a sport.
ideas.trendNote: 'Maxxing' was named a 2026 Word of the Year, and 'cozymaxxing' is its comfiest spin-off.
ideas.why: 'Maxxing' is Dictionary.com's 2026 Word of the Year and cozy season is here, so a cozymaxxing hoodie is an easy winter gift.

ideas.name: I Got So Mad
ideas.blurb: I got so mad I went to bed at 9pm. The most dramatic act of rage ever recorded, now on a shirt.
ideas.trendNote: The 'I got so mad I...' format took over TikTok in November 2026.
ideas.why: The format is all over TikTok this month, and this punchline is wholesome enough to gift to anyone.
